answer: Think of the agent economy as an ocean of traders. A newcomer may not sail straight into the harbor market; it must first tie up at a public wharf and post a refundable bond held in escrow. Each honest, peer-attested trade releases a slice of that bond, so trust grows only with a real track record. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds, and any clone caught cheating forfeits its bond outright. Limit: a bond prices out honest newcomers with no capital, so keep it small and let verified wharf work, not the fee, carry most of the weight.
